executable: 1e-6 through arrays, json, terminal and the disposable warehouse

reference_evidence.why: no literature reference has been re-executed on this task; no contract of another work is registered

comparability.resolution: a re-execution of a reference method under THIS contract, CLOSED under this digest (MATCHED_DOMAIN_COMPARISON); never a published number from another protocol
comparability.why: no literature reference has been re-executed on this task; no contract of another work is registered

benchmark_contract.metric_aggregation: per horizon, fold, seed and arm; paired by origin
benchmark_contract.metric_formula: MAE_z = mean|yhat-y|/sd_train per horizon and fold; RMSE_z; skill = 1 - MAE_z_model/MAE_z_naive
benchmark_contract.missing_policy: non-finite bars withdrawn; weekend/holiday gaps kept; an origin whose elapsed-time target bar is absent is excluded with reason
benchmark_contract.naive_baseline: persistence: the origin's close, on identical origins
notes: no literature reference bound: NOT_COMPARABLE until a matched re-execution exists
benchmark_contract.permitted_inputs: OHLCV of the served bars (5 channels), window 60
benchmark_contract.scaler_fit_population: train rows of the fold, shared by every arm of the fold
benchmark_contract.split_rule: weekly walk-forward folds (Monday 00:00 UTC .. Sunday 23:00 UTC); DEV = the last 26 weeks before 2025-01-01
benchmark_contract.target_construction: hourly bar close as served; the target of an origin is the bar whose timestamp is origin + h hours ELAPSED (tools/df_fin_task.map_targets); an origin without that exact bar is excluded and counted
benchmark_contract.tuning_budget: equal enumerated candidates per loss family

candidates.budget_per_fit: the recipe's update ceiling and cadence, identical for every candidate; observed updates recorded per cell
candidates.identifiability: the same 3 learning rates for every (loss, optimizer) cell: the optimizer contrast is not confounded with the size of its tuning budget; decay and delta move in their own declared populations
candidates.selection_scope: configuration-level selection INSIDE population B (validation MAE_z averaged over seeds); A is reported as the fixed-default 2x2 contrast; C and D are reported as factors; no selection across populations

cost_envelope.basis: synthetic acceptance on the compact receiver (W60, 5 channels): ~0.02-0.06 s per update on omega class CPUs; a 1500-update cell with 15 validation events on ~120 validation pairs costs well under 60 s; the real task's population per fold (52 weeks x 120 bars) makes an update cost comparable
cost_envelope.per_horizon_per_receiver: 26 fits x 3 seeds x 26 folds = 2 028 cells -> a train-only cost pilot on the real bars decides the fold count and receiver per round; NOT authorised until the design is reviewed
cost_envelope.rule: pilot first, projection with validation counted once, never shrink the population after scores

delta_rules: Huber deltas in z from the admissible train pairs; every rule is declared and every candidate is finite and > 0.

hosts.blocks: all candidates of a (fold, seed) on one host; workers proven with an accounted bounded governed child (RP78)

provenance.adam: Kingma & Ba 2015 (installed Keras defaults beta_1 0.9, beta_2 0.999, epsilon 1e-7)
provenance.adamw: Loshchilov & Hutter 2019 decoupled weight decay (Keras AdamW; biases excluded from decay — our declaration)
provenance.huber: Huber 1964; delta in standardised units from the admissible train residual scale — our construction
no_universal_claims: AdamW depends only on parameter count

compact_modular.head: Dense(p) increment over the last observation; the target channel (close) is read out

receivers.rule: both receivers run every candidate; no candidate is compared across receivers; width, depth and inputs are frozen here

recipe.monitor: validation MAE in scaled units (MAE_z with the fold's train sigma)

reporting.inference: paired by fold (week) between each family's validation-selected candidate; moving-block bootstrap interval; multiplicity = candidates compared per family, declared; no best-test
reporting.precision: predictions and targets saved without rounding; metrics in float64; the float64 floor at the observed MAE_z recorded per cell; min_delta 0
reporting.resolvable: differences down to the float64 floor at ~0.5 (about 1e-16) survive arrays, json and the warehouse; what is DISTINGUISHABLE by inference is bounded by the fold-to-fold spread, reported, not assumed
reporting.scale: MAE_z = mean|yhat-y|/sigma_train per fold, shared by every candidate of the fold; original units secondarily

resolution: planted 1e-5/1e-6 differences survive prediction, inversion, serialization, terminal and warehouse bit-for-bit (FL04/FL08); the float64 floor (np.spacing) is a representation bound only — stochastic training variation (seeds) and sampling uncertainty (folds) are reported apart and bound what is DISTINGUISHABLE
runner: tools/df_fin_runner.py (prepare / execute / close); acceptance FL01-FL08 on synthetic bars through the disposable stack

selection_and_replication.populations: A fixed-default 2x2 reported as a contrast; B equal-budget LR (3 LRs for EVERY loss x optimizer cell) is where selection happens; C decay and D delta are declared factors; no selection across populations
selection_and_replication.scheme: CONFIGURATION-LEVEL: a candidate's validation MAE_z in a fold is the mean over the declared seeds; a configuration is complete only with every seed present; the seeds are then RETAINED as paired replicates for the development-test contrast (one difference series per seed); never best-of-seeds

stop_rule: validation every 100 observed optimizer updates, patience 3 events, min_delta 0, restore best, ceiling 1500 updates; both triggers recorded; reaching the ceiling is CENSORED whatever the best event

availability.declared: a bar's label is the time it is complete (lake contract: event time = available time); the decision at t reads labels <= t only
availability.rule: recorded as limitations; nothing about the producer is invented

folds.dev: the last 26 complete weeks strictly before the reserve
folds.identities: derived at prepare from the delivered bars (tools/df_fin_task.dev_folds), recorded per fold
folds.purge: the horizon in hours between train targets and validation origins, and between validation targets and test origins
folds.scheme: weekly walk-forward by week identity (Monday 00:00 .. Sunday 23:00 on the label's clock)
folds.validation: the week before the test week

h6.mapping: ELAPSED TIME: the bar labelled exactly origin + hours; absent -> excluded with reason (weekend, holiday, missing intraday bar); never the next retained row
h6.why: one quarter of a trading day at this resolution; declared before any score

h72.mapping: ELAPSED TIME: the bar labelled exactly origin + hours; absent -> excluded with reason (weekend, holiday, missing intraday bar); never the next retained row
h72.why: about three days of elapsed time; declared before any score

task.input_window: the last W RETAINED bars ending at the origin (row identity; declared — the window is not an elapsed-time span; W retained bars and W elapsed hours are different things and only the target uses elapsed time)
task.missing_policy: declared and IMPLEMENTED on the consumed tensors (tools/df_fin_task.admissible_pairs): a pair is admissible only when every input role is finite on every one of its W window rows, its origin and label are finite, and every window row is available at the origin; excluded pairs are counted by reason; no imputation, no implicit zero; a fold whose split has fewer than the declared minimum admissible pairs produces NO score
task.naive: persistence: the origin's close, on identical pairs
task.population_rule: ONE shared admissible population per fold and split for every candidate; the train-only input scaler, the target sigma and the Huber residual scale are derived from the SAME admissible train pairs

reserve.rule: never read; deliveries are bounded ranges before it

target.transform_for_evaluation: zscore with the fold's train sigma

task.timestamps: labels are interpreted on the delivered producer contract: a UTC-offset-aware column is converted only under the declared rule timestamp_interpretation=UTC_OFFSET_AWARE, never stripped; an available-time column, when the contract provides one, governs which rows an origin may read (a late arrival withdraws the origins it would leak into)
what_the_archive_can_support: retrospective elapsed-time forecasting error on served bars
paired loss/optimizer contrasts on identical pairs
DEV-fold sensitivity at 1e-5/1e-6 through the real path
what_the_archive_cannot_support: observed availability, completion lag or point-in-time eligibility (availability is UNDECLARED: the label is the basis and the record says so)

uncertainty.coverage_validated: dependent AR(1) synthetic controls (tests): 26 folds / block 4 / rho 0.3 -> adequate; 104 folds / block 8 / rho 0.6 -> adequate; 26 folds / block 4 / rho 0.6 -> ~0.69, ANTI-CONSERVATIVE: at 26 DEV weeks the interval is reported with this caveat and the sign counts and sample SD (ddof=1) are the primary reading
uncertainty.method: moving-block bootstrap of the paired difference over CALENDAR fold positions (missing folds stay gaps; a block never straddles a gap); minimum support = 5 complete blocks and 2 x block length folds, else DESCRIPTIVE
uncertainty.never: seeds or overlapping windows treated as independent weeks; a nominal interval from one block

what_this_is_not: not a run, not a winner, not a trading loss; the household factorial selects nothing financial
